result.question: What does the king say to the man of God?

readings.answer: Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.
readings.support: Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.

readings.answer: Intercede with the LORD your God and pray for me that my hand may be restored.
readings.support: Intercede with the LORD your God and pray for me that my hand may be restored.

assessments.reason: This exactly quotes v7: “Then the king said to the man of God, ‘Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward,’” matching the key’s sense of coming home for a reward.
In v6, “the king responded to the man of God…,” which is also something the king said to the man of God; the question does not specify which of the two speeches is intended.

result.reason: The passage records two different things the king says to the man of God (vv.6–7), and the question does not indicate which one is sought.
